title: Last Quarter
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Unhappy at home, 17-year-old Mizuki falls for Adam, a mysterious British musician, and plans to run away with him, but is hit by a car. Fifth-grader Hotaru, recovering from her own accident, finds a ghostly girl with no memories in an abandoned mansion; with three classmates she uncovers who the girl is, why a long-dead musician and his late girlfriend are tied to her, and how to bring her back to life.
life_message: Being loved by family and friends gives a person the will to live, even when escape seems more appealing.

content.note: A car accident; no fighting reported (Wikipedia).
Ghosts, possession, a coma and near death; melancholy grief (Wikipedia, ANN; MU Ghost/s, Coma, Near-Death Experience).
A 17-year-old drawn into secret nightly meetings with an older man a reviewer calls a 'walking red flag' (ANN, Wikipedia; AniList Age Gap low rank). No sexual content reported.
Adam presumably died of drug addiction; ANN content warning lists drug abuse (Wikipedia, ANN).
Mizuki's despair and wish to escape; recovered will to live; AniList Suicide spoiler tag (Wikipedia, AniList).
Running away from home to follow a stranger is shown leading to harm (Wikipedia).

dominant: Will to live; love beyond death; childhood friendship
